meta.model: Frozen 2025-selected, position-specific stat-first models; score calculated from coherent box-score forecasts
limitations: 2026 Week 10 pregame snapshot: excludes the single Week 10 game from training and 2026 features.
2026 weekly source lacks deep-target attempts; 20+ yard receptions used as an approximate deep-target proxy.
No injury/availability adjustment; ranked cohort includes players with prior recorded opportunities.
Advanced opponent-adjusted features are research-only pending another independent validation.
Alignment, QB rushes inside 10 and RYOE are not integrated without verified free pregame feeds.
